name: Okto
_comment: Instrument: 8-operator FM synthesizer, engine after libfmsynth, envelopes in the manner of FM8 (okto_core.h), SHAPE wavetable modulator (okto_shape.h). vst.json/module.json only feed mpc-vst-plugins' tools/gen_vst.py for params.h + the skin. module.json and okto_params.h come from tools/gen_okto.py. The plugin is okto_vst.cpp, built by this port's own build.sh.
